rationale.reason: Delivered railway infrastructure, electrification and listed cable systems match; rolling stock and transport operations are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Applies to actual completed railway infrastructure: long-line and commuter roadbeds, street tramways, underground/elevated rapid-transit rail infrastructure, electrification structures, track control/safety systems, and funicular/cable-car fixed systems. One project-defined physical delivery unit is assessed through its actual construction and acceptance, including renewal deliveries with retained assets explicitly identified. This is an entity method, not a construction service, rail transport service, rolling-stock manufacturing PCR or a package of building materials.

The core foreground begins with the recorded site starting condition and supplied materials/equipment at the declared receiving gates and ends with documented acceptance and agreed site restoration. Upstream manufacture, inbound transport, construction waste treatment and test-vehicle use are separate linked contributions with explicit coverage. Exclude normal passenger/freight operation, subsequent maintenance/replacement and final demolition by default; describe those separately if a larger study adds them. Do not claim full cradle-to-gate or whole-life coverage from this foreground. CPC bridge/viaduct structures and tunnel shells are separately classified assets, while the rail systems installed through/on them can be included with a clear interface. Station buildings and rolling stock are separately assessed.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Actual delivered railway infrastructure listed above and complete agreed cable systems
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Transport/construction services; standalone materials and rolling-stock production; separately delivered bridge/tunnel shells and station buildings; post-delivery operation, maintenance and demolition
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Completed on-site physical asset with recorded acceptance; interfaces and retained assets declared for partial deliveries

limitations: Candidate methodology; independent scientific review pending; no publication or engineering/compliance approval.
All CPC railway entity routes retained; actual work packages require complete measured atomic inventories. Example rows are not a universal recipe.
No default lifespan, per-km or whole-asset mass, geometry, design load, material ratio, emission factor or construction energy.
Site construction-to-delivery foreground only; upstream manufacture, transport, waste treatment, later operation/maintenance/demolition require separately declared coverage.
Historical HS2 proposals and manufacturer refurbishment example provide qualitative process context only; actual project specifications and acceptance control applicability.
